facts.business: Manipal Finance Corporation Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) that has fully repaid public deposits, debentures, and subordinated debts, with funds historically blocked in Non Performing Assets.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to going concern doubt as majority of funds are blocked in Non Performing Assets and the company has incurred losses; Emphasis of Matter regarding remittance of unclaimed matured debentures and subordinated debts to Investor Education and Protection Fund except disputed amounts of INR 158 thousands.

key_risks: Going concern doubt due to incurred losses and majority of funds blocked in Non Performing Assets
Inability to comment on ultimate realisability of Company's assets including Property, Plant & Equipment under lease
Inability to comment on Company's ability to settle its liabilities
Disputed amounts of INR 158 thousands pending before Consumer Courts
